selection_basis: Representative chip, network, display and audio build paths across widely used boards. Mirrors the upstream CI list, except the S31 Korvo entry (absent on c6-dev-kit-n16-upstream-sync) is replaced by the branch's primary target.

variants.name: esp32-c6-dev-kit-n16
variants.reason: Primary target of c6-dev-kit-n16-upstream-sync branch (ESP32-C6, model partition)

variants.name: xmini-c3
variants.reason: Most active C3 board; OLED, lightweight wake word detection and power saving

variants.name: jiuchuan-s3
variants.reason: Most active S3 board; SPI LCD and Wi-Fi

variants.name: bread-compact-wifi
variants.reason: S3 with a 128x32 OLED and basic I2S audio

variants.name: esp-hi
variants.reason: C3 with 4MB flash, small partitions, ADC audio and lightweight wake word detection

variants.name: bread-compact-wifi-lcd
variants.reason: Widely used basic S3 LCD configuration

variants.name: xingzhi-cube-1.54tft-wifi
variants.reason: Widely used Xingzhi S3 board with Wi-Fi and LCD

variants.name: lichuang-dev
variants.reason: S3 camera, BoxAudioCodec and device-side AEC

variants.name: bread-compact-esp32
variants.reason: Original ESP32 target and its source exclusion rules
